view: Frontal (PA) chest radiograph, upright, L marker upper right of image (conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate. Slightly shallow inspiration (right hemidiaphragm at about the anterior 5th-6th rib), minimal rotation, moderate penetration. Large body habitus with abundant chest wall and upper-abdominal soft tissue; scapulae partly overlap the upper lateral lung fields. No lines, tubes, clips, pacemaker or other devices; the only external artifact is the L side marker.

abnormalities.finding: Ill-defined, mildly lobulated mass-like opacity at the right hilum / medial right lung extending from the middle into the lower zone, approximately 4 cm, right hilum denser and more bulky than the left (suspicious for a central mass or hilar adenopathy)
Mild prominence of the left hilum (less than right; possibly vascular)
Shallow inspiration with mildly crowded basal vasculature; large body habitus

description_zh: 正面（PA）胸部X光，吸氣稍淺、體型較大，未見任何管路、引流管或植入裝置。右側肺門及其內下方可見一邊界不清、略呈分葉狀之腫塊樣緻密影，約4公分，右肺門較左側明顯增大且緻密，疑為中央型腫塊或肺門淋巴結腫大；左肺門輕度突出。其餘肺野未見明顯實變、結節或氣胸，雙側肋膈角銳利，無肋膜積液。心臟大小約在正常上限、縱膈與氣管居中，骨骼結構完整；建議進一步胸部CT評估右肺門病灶。
